description: This file defines the class AjaxCompose, which manages dynamic user interface components such as sections, breadcrumbs, and error messaging for a web application module, likely related to module building or customization in a CRM system.

classes.name: AjaxCompose
classes.description: Handles UI components including sections, breadcrumbs, and error status display for the module.

methods.name: addSection
methods.description: Adds a content section to the UI with a specified name, title, content, and action.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded string of the current sections for client-side rendering.

methods.name: addCrumb
methods.description: Adds a breadcrumb trail item with a specified name and action.

methods.name: getBreadCrumb
methods.description: Generates HTML code for the breadcrumb navigation based on the current crumbs.

methods.name: echoErrorStatus
methods.description: Outputs a JSON-encoded error status message.
